of Little Red River Park. The Prince Albert Sports Hall of Fame inducted 7 new individuals and 2 new teams to the Hall of Fame. The Prince Albert Arts Hall of Fame inducted two visual artists and three musicians into the
Arts Hall of Fame. PAHS continued hosting of the Junior Historical Society for children ages 8 and up; now made into two groups, ages 8-12 and ages 12 and up. The Historical Society and the Diefenbaker Canada
Centre partnered to install a new exhibition at the Diefenbaker Museum, "Silk, Satin & Strength" highlighting Olive Diefenbaker's clothing. PAHS partnered with Live History to present "Here Before" an immersive
experience. PAHS hosted a tour of the Sacred Heart Cathedral for PA Historical Society Members. PAGC hosted the "When Time Heals - Every Child Matters" event to honour the lives, voices, and futures of Indigenous
children on the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation. The PAGC Women's Commission hosted a National Indigenous Peoples Day and wildfire relief fundraiser. PAHS hosted Mini Explorer (ages 8-12) half-day
camps. PAHS hosted day camps in July and August; Day in the life of a voyageur, and Day in the life of a settler. PAHS offered the "Travelling Suitcase Program" providing individuals with themed learning materials.
PAHS hosted the Remembrance Day Open House and Presentation. PAMC hosted Multicultural Canada Day Celebration.
